public_family_candidate: saga/compensating-transaction recovery for partially completed assignment switches

fatal_gates.F1: immutable prior assignment/switch history is never rewritten or deleted; recovery is append-only qualification state
fatal_gates.F2: no richer-mode/manual-user/protected-primary/external hosted orchestrator, finite quota, or incremental monetary cost on accepted route

guards: G1 each switch attempt has a durable instance id, source assignment, target assignment, and ordered step status before any semantic effect is credited
G2 recovery appends step/compensation events; it never edits or deletes prior switch evidence
G3 after interruption, if the target preconditions are still valid, resume from the first incomplete forward step rather than restart completed steps
G4 if target preconditions are no longer valid, compensate only already-completed reversible steps and do so in reverse order
G5 every compensation has a stable idempotency identity; duplicate replay cannot apply the semantic reversal twice
G6 a late stale completion from the old forward path cannot reactivate a target after that switch instance has entered compensation or terminal abort
G7 the last durably committed assignment remains authoritative until a distinct target-active terminal readback; nonterminal preparation never creates double-credit or zero-authority
G8 transport/CAS/readback failure is non-semantic and resumes from the last durable step state
G9 switch/recovery credit is zero until one exact terminal outcome is independently read back, and duplicate terminal replay cannot add credit
G10 bounded exact-scope exit with nonempty frontier and zero residual richer-mode/user execution, zero finite quota, zero incremental monetary cost

case_forward.required_terminal: B_ACTIVE; A superseded only after B_ACTIVE readback

case_compensate.later_condition: new same-scope evidence invalidates B before terminal activation
case_compensate.required_terminal: SW-8 ABORTED after idempotent compensation of B_PREPARED; A remains authoritative

case_duplicate_compensation.input: same compensation identity replayed after successful compensation

case_stale_forward.input: late B_ACTIVE completion from SW-8 after SW-8 ABORTED

candidate_patterns.pattern: blindly restart the whole switch after interruption
always roll back immediately, even when safe forward completion is available
durable saga-like step log; resume forward when valid, otherwise reverse-order idempotent compensation; terminal readback gates authority and credit
delegate recovery to an external hosted workflow/orchestrator

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G10 PASS. Do not change cases, guards, or candidate patterns after public source read.
credit_rule: Precommit and nonterminal recovery steps earn zero credit. At most one new leaf credit only after a source-qualified Chat-native reduction passes all fixed cases and immutable terminal evidence is independently read back.
exact_next_action: Read this precommit back. Then, before any other family selection, audit primary/public saga or compensating-transaction sources, bind only source-supported recovery semantics, assess zero dependency/quota/cost, execute SC-A..SC-D against the fixed cases, and seal/read back terminal evidence before credit.
